CollectionDetail.nameInUse.test.tsx:163-176 waits for toast.error and then uses waitFor for the reloaded title button. This matches CollectionDetail.tsx:126-128, which closes the field, toasts and then calls load() asynchronously on a non-409 failure.
regression_risks: CollectionDetail.nameInUse.test.tsx:167 reads queryByDisplayValue('Elsewhere') synchronously right after waitFor sees toast.error. toast.error is called in the same continuation as setEditingName(false) (CollectionDetail.tsx:126-127). Whether React has re-rendered by that point depends on the Testing Library asyncWrapper's post-wait drain, which I could not confirm without running the tests. If the field has not closed yet, the test types into a field that is about to unmount. The fallback branch suggests the author expected both states, so this is a residual timing risk rather than a demonstrated defect.
